lines.japanese: 蛇足になるかもしれないが、事の顛末をざっくり語っておこう。
lines.english: Maybe this is more than you need to know, but here’s a quick rundown of how it all ended.

lines.japanese: 「ある夜、龍声舎の若頭が、趣味として彫刻を始めるため、知人から道具を借りるつもりだった──」
lines.english: “One night, the underboss of Ryuuseisha planned to borrow tools from an acquaintance so he could take up sculpture as a hobby—”

lines.japanese: 「──しかし、その受け渡し場所に居合わせた児島組の構成員が、言いがかりをつけて襲いかかってきた」
lines.english: “—but a member of the Torashima Group who happened to be at the exchange picked a fight and attacked him on a false pretext.”

lines.japanese: これが、両組のあいだに結果として残った事実だ。ときとして事実と真実は合致しない。
lines.english: That was the fact left standing between the two organizations. Sometimes fact and truth are not the same.

lines.japanese: 虎島側は、勘違い（本当は勘違いでもないが）から龍声舎に粗相したことを、急ぎ謝罪したらしい。
lines.english: Torashima apparently hurried to apologize for insulting Ryuuseisha over a misunderstanding—even if it hadn't truly been a misunderstanding.

lines.japanese: 大義名分があるならまだしも、自らに非のある喧嘩を始められるほど、虎島の地力は大きくないという。
lines.english: Torashima was not powerful enough to start a fight while plainly in the wrong. A plausible justification would have been another matter.

lines.japanese: 結果、龍声舎は虎島組に、大きな貸しをひとつ作ったことになる。
lines.english: As a result, Ryuuseisha gained one considerable hold over the Torashima Group.

lines.japanese: ギルティはこの一連の流れを、自らが仕組んだものだと上に報告したらしい。組に貢献し、面子を立てたことで、脱会への大きな足掛かりを得たと言っている。
lines.english: Guilty apparently reported to his superiors that he had engineered the entire sequence. By contributing to the organization and preserving its honor, he said, he had secured a major foothold toward leaving it.

lines.japanese: どうも門外顧問から親分サンへの口添えもあったようだが、それに関してはマスターから口止めされているのか、ギルティは明言を避けていた。
lines.english: It also sounded as if an outside adviser had put in a word with the boss. Perhaps the manager had ordered him to keep quiet about that, because Guilty avoided saying so outright.

lines.japanese: ともあれ俺は、その話をパルクレープで聞いた。
lines.english: In any case, I heard this story at Paru Crêpes.

lines.japanese: やつはすっかり常連だ。例のオヤジ臭い下ジョークでパルさんを怒らせてばかりだが、本人は一向に懲りる様子がない。
lines.english: He had become a full-fledged regular. His endless old-man sex jokes kept infuriating Paru, but he showed no sign of learning his lesson.

lines.japanese: 呆れたやつだが、エージの解放に尽力してもらった義理がある俺は、しばらく大目に見てやろうと思う。
lines.english: He was hopeless, but I owed him for working to secure Eiji's release, so I planned to overlook it for a while.

lines.japanese: 追伸。
lines.english: Postscript.

lines.japanese: 気まぐれにバッグの中身をすりかえていた某皇帝が、その後ブツをどう処理したのか。
lines.english: What did a certain capricious Emperor do with the real product after switching the contents of the bag?

lines.japanese: 俺は知らない。蛇の道は蛇。
lines.english: I don't know. It takes a snake to know a snake.

lines.japanese: 事件の明くる日、俺は例によってエージからの電話で真っ昼間に起こされた。
lines.english: The day after the incident, Eiji woke me in broad daylight with yet another phone call.

lines.japanese: 『おうドラ、おまえ何したんだ？」
lines.english: “Dora, what the hell did you do?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ……？　なにが……」
lines.english: “Huh...? What are you talking about...?”

lines.japanese: ケータイ片手に、重いまぶたを開ける。当然だが、鳴はもう学校へ行ったあとみたいだ。
lines.english: Phone in hand, I forced my heavy eyelids open. Naturally, Naru seemed to have left for school already.

lines.japanese: 『なにがじゃねえよ。俺はブツを安全な場所へ移せって頼んだんだよ、なに虎島んトコ戻してんだよ」
lines.english: “Don't give me that. I told you to move the product somewhere safe. Why'd you send it back to Torashima?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　知らねえよ、俺じゃねえ」
lines.english: “How should I know? Wasn't me.”

lines.japanese: 俺はおまえが海の底へ沈められないよう計らっただけだ。
lines.english: All I had done was arrange matters so he didn't end up at the bottom of the ocean.

lines.japanese: 事情は見えないが、鳳がそうさせたのなら、それが最良の策だったんだろう。
lines.english: I couldn't see the whole picture, but if Kakeru had caused that outcome, it must have been the best one available.

lines.japanese: 『ったく、せっかくの計画がパアじゃねえか。もうちょっと温めときゃ、ドサクサに紛れてよその組の手に渡ったっつーことに出来たんだよ」
lines.english: “Goddammit. There goes my whole plan. If I'd sat on it a little longer, I could've made it look like some other outfit took it in all the confusion.”

lines.japanese: 「そしたらアレが俺んとこに残って、めでたしめでたしじゃないか」
lines.english: “Then the stuff stays with me, and everybody lives happily ever after.”

lines.japanese: こいつ、そんな馬鹿げたこと企ててたのか。
lines.english: He had actually been plotting something that stupid?

lines.japanese: 「アホか。その前にことがバレておまえ沈んでただろ」
lines.english: “Idiot. They'd have caught you and sunk you first.”

lines.japanese: 『……やっぱ、そう思う？」
lines.english: “...You think?”

lines.japanese: 「当たりまえだ。いまその口でグダグダ言えることを喜んどけ」
lines.english: “Obviously. Be grateful you're still here to whine at me.”

lines.japanese: 『あァ……だよなァ……いや、俺もちょっと早まったかァ？　って後悔はあったんだ」
lines.english: “Yeah... You're right... I had started regretting jumping the gun.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そ。じゃあ学習したな、二度と馬鹿な真似すんじゃねえぞ」
lines.english: “Good. You learned something. Never pull a stupid stunt like that again.”

lines.japanese: 『あ、待て！　待てって、まだ切ンなよ。本題はこっからだって！」
lines.english: “Wait! Don't hang up yet. I haven't even reached the point!”

lines.japanese: 「本題……？　テメまさか、この期に及んでまだ俺にヤバい仕事させようってんじゃねえだろーな。さすがにキレるぞ」
lines.english: “The point...? You'd better not be trying to give me another dangerous job after all this. I really will lose it.”

lines.japanese: 『違げえって馬鹿。給料！　今回の件、上手くやったら５万つったろ！」
lines.english: “No, idiot. Your pay! I said you'd get fifty thousand if this went well!”

lines.japanese: 五万……？
lines.english: Fifty thousand... ?

lines.japanese: ああ、そういや、当初はそんな話だったな。どさくさですっかり忘れていた。
lines.english: Oh, right. That had been the original deal. In all the confusion, I'd completely forgotten.

lines.japanese: 『ま、依頼通りに仕事したわけじゃねーから、多少さっ引いといたけどよ。これで今回の件はチャラな」
lines.english: “Well, you didn't do the job the way I asked, so I took a little off. This makes us even.”

lines.japanese: 憎まれ口は相変わらずだが、素直に報酬を出すってのは、こいつにしちゃ殊勝な方だ。
lines.english: The hateful tone was the same as ever, but actually paying what he owed was admirably honest by Eiji's standards.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ……」
詳しいことは知らされてないだろうに、俺に対して一応の恩義は感じてるってことか。
lines.english: He probably hadn't been told the details, but did he at least feel some debt toward me?

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうな。あとでコンビニ行って確認しとくわ」
lines.english: “Yeah, okay. I'll check at the convenience store later.”

lines.japanese: 俺はむっくり体を起こした。
lines.english: I heaved myself upright.

lines.japanese: やつからの金なんて毎度ロクなもんじゃないが、今回ばかりは受けとってもバチは当たらないだろう。
lines.english: Money from him never brought anything good, but after this mess, accepting it couldn't bring divine punishment either.

lines.japanese: そうだ。これで鳴を旅行にでも連れてってやるか。
lines.english: Right. Maybe I'd use it to take Naru on a trip.

lines.japanese: 『んじゃ、そゆことで！　またなんか仕事あったら振ってやるからよ、よろしく頼むわ」
lines.english: “Then we're settled! I'll throw more work your way whenever it comes up. Counting on you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　馬鹿いってんじゃねーよ、だから成田工務店はとっくに廃業したってなんべん言わせりゃ……」
lines.english: “What? Don't be an idiot. How many times do I have to tell you Narita Construction went out of business ages ago—”

lines.japanese: 『あやべっ！　悪りい、いま俺の金ヅルが女優業やめたいとか言い出してさ。プロダクションの社長と二人がかりで説得してたとこなんだわ」
lines.english: “Oh, shit! Sorry. My meal ticket just started saying she wants to quit acting. Me and her agency president were talking her down.”

lines.japanese: 『向こうの話も終わったみたいだから切るな！　じゃあんね～ん！」
lines.english: “Looks like they're done too, so I gotta go. Later!”

lines.japanese: やはりあいつはアホだ。いつかまた同じような騒動を起こすんじゃないだろうか。
lines.english: He really was an idiot. Sooner or later, he would probably cause another disaster just like this one.

lines.japanese: 俺はうんざりして電話を放った。
lines.english: Thoroughly disgusted, I tossed the phone aside.

lines.japanese: やつが今回、優しき他人のおかげで命拾いしたことは、またの機会に教えてやろう。まずは鳳から、その件に関する情報公開が許されているのか確認するのが先だ。
lines.english: I could tell him another time that kind strangers had saved his life. First, I needed to ask Kakeru how much of the matter I was allowed to reveal.

lines.japanese: などと考えていた矢先、ケータイが震えだして、発信者通知欄に鳳翔の名が浮かんだ。
lines.english: Just as the thought crossed my mind, my phone began to vibrate, and the name Kakeru Ohtori appeared on the screen.

lines.japanese: 『隼人ぉ～？　さっそく昨日の貸しを返してほしいんだけどー」
lines.english: “Hayato? I'd like you to pay back yesterday's favor right away.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 早いな。しかし今回ばかりは俺に拒否権はない。なんであれ、やつの命には従おう。
lines.english: That was fast. But this time, I had no right to refuse. Whatever the command, I would obey it.

lines.japanese: 「分かった。約束は守る、なんでも言え」
lines.english: “Fine. I keep my promises. Name it.”

lines.japanese: 『じゃあ、今晩ヘテロ来て」
lines.english: “Come to Hetero tonight.”

lines.japanese: 「ヘテロ？」
lines.english: “Hetero?”

lines.japanese: ゆうべ行ったばっかだっつーの。
lines.english: I'd just been there last night.

lines.japanese: 「いや、行けっつーなら行くけど、でも今日はべつの場所にした方がいいぞ。すっげーうるさくて話になんねえと思うし」
lines.english: “If that's what you want, I'll go. But you should pick somewhere else today. It'll be way too loud to talk.”

lines.japanese: 「あそこ、なんか昨日からヤンチャな小僧どもが集まって、ヘンなケンカ大会みたいのやってんだよ」
lines.english: “A bunch of rowdy little punks have been gathering there since yesterday for some weird fighting tournament.”

lines.japanese: 『柳木原一の強者を決めるＹ１グランプリ」
lines.english: “The Y1 Grand Prix to decide Yanagihara's strongest.”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう、ソレ」
lines.english: “Yeah. That.”

lines.japanese: 『うん。エントリーしたから」
lines.english: “Yeah. All signed up.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえも出んのかよ」
lines.english: “You're fighting too?”

lines.japanese: 『おまえも出るんだよ」
lines.english: “You’re fighting too.”

lines.japanese: 「はああ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 『出場して優勝目指すこと。これがおまえの債務の返済条件」
lines.english: “Enter and aim for the championship. That's the condition for repaying your debt.”
“G-ggh...”

lines.japanese: 『拒否権ないんだから、あんま悩まない方がいいよ。ああ、あと、そろそろ迎えが着くと思うから」
lines.english: “You don't have a choice, so don't waste too much time agonizing. Oh, and your ride should be arriving soon.”
“My ride...?”

lines.japanese: 電話を切った直後。
lines.english: Immediately after he hung up—

lines.japanese: という出来すぎたタイミングで、インターホンが鳴った。
lines.english: —with timing far too perfect to be natural, the intercom rang.

lines.japanese: おそるおそる出てみる。
lines.english: I nervously answered it.

lines.japanese: 『はーやとクン！　あっそびましょ～♪」
lines.english: “Haaayato! Come out and plaaay!”

lines.japanese: おまえら、ぜってー連絡取りあってタイミング計っただろ……。
lines.english: You assholes absolutely coordinated that timing...

lines.japanese: そしてさらに嘘くさいタイミングで鳴る俺のケータイ。
lines.english: Then, with even more implausible timing, my phone rang again.

lines.japanese: 「あん？　誰だ、この番号……もしもし」
lines.english: “Hm? Who's calling from this number...? Hello?”

lines.japanese: 『御機嫌いかがァ、クレイジーファルコン。ゆうべの貸しを返していただく機会が出来ましたよォ」
lines.english: “How do you do, Crazy Falcon? An opportunity has arisen for you to repay last night's debt.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、アレか……おう、なんだ。もうヤケだ、なんでも言え」
lines.english: “Oh. That... Fine. I'm past caring. Name it.”

lines.japanese: 『あんた知ってるかい、柳木原一の強者を決めるＹ１グラン──」
lines.english: “Do you know of the Y1 Grand Prix to decide Yanagihara's strongest—”

lines.japanese: 「上等だァ！　参加しまくってテメエらボコボコにしてやるァ！」
lines.english: “Bring it on! I'll enter the shit out of it and beat every last one of you senseless!”

lines.japanese: 「ククク……ハハハハ！　来たのかファルコン、おまえも血を持てあましていたとはなァ！」
lines.english: “Heh heh... Hahahaha! So you came, Falcon. So your blood was restless too!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえに呼びつけられたんだよ」
lines.english: “You summoned me.”

lines.japanese: 「ふン、暇な連中だ。まともな大人の遊びじゃない」
lines.english: “Hmph. What idle fools. This is no pastime for a respectable adult.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、じゃあ帰れよ。なにシード枠で参加してんだよ」
lines.english: “Then go home. Why are you competing as a seeded entrant?”

lines.japanese: 「フフ、股間の青い若造どもめ。優勝はこの伝説の不良、ミスターＳＥＸがいただいてやるぜ！」
lines.english: “Heh. Green little boys, every one of you. The championship belongs to this legendary delinquent, Mr. SEX!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ミスターなんとかじゃねえだろ。あんた軽部狩男だろうが。つか、なんでこんなトコいんだよ」
lines.english: “You're not Mr. Anything. You're Karuo Karube. And why the hell are you here?”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、ＯＢを疎外する気か？　俺はかつて柳木原にその名を轟かせた伝説のバッドボーイだぞ、参加する権利はあるだろう」
lines.english: “What, you mean to exclude an alumnus? I am a legendary bad boy whose name once thundered across Yanagihara. Surely I have the right to compete.”

lines.japanese: 「そうじゃなくて。あんたもうとっくにカタギなんだし、こんなガキ同士のケンカごっこにゃ興味ねえはずだろ」
lines.english: “That isn't what I mean. You went straight years ago. You shouldn't care about children play-fighting.”

lines.japanese: 「フッ……虎は牙を抜かれても虎だった、ってことかな。男はいくつになっても男なんだよ」
lines.english: “Hmph... A tiger remains a tiger even after its fangs are pulled. A man remains a man at any age.”

lines.japanese: 「優勝したら皇帝が合コンのセッティングしてあげるって言ったらしいよ」
lines.english: “Apparently, the Emperor promised to arrange a group date for the winner.”

lines.japanese: 「ようし、かかってこい坊主ども！　俺たちの戦いはこれからだァ！」
lines.english: “All right, come at me, boys! Our battle is only beginning!”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、声が小せえ！　てめえら、もう一丁イクぞ！　キシャアアアー！」
lines.english: “Hah! I can't hear you! One more time! Kshaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「デストロォーイ！」
lines.english: “Destroooy!”

lines.japanese: 「おっぱァ──い！」
lines.english: “Boooobies!”

lines.japanese: 「帰りてえええー！」
lines.english: “I wanna go hoooome!”
